says: A window's control group at the tab row's right end, its foot under the body's top line (ctl.corner in Ordaen/art.luna): every control a plate with a glyph on it. ctl-corner-plate.tga: rows of 64 x 32 px (128 x 64 texels), each a plate with what lies round it, the rim's shadow 3 px above and 1 px beside: bronze first of the group (the group's rim on its left and top, the corner rounded), bronze after another (a divider on its left, the rim above it), bronze last (the rim on its right and top, rounded), red last; each normal, hover, pressed; no rim under any (the body's line covers the foot). ctl-corner-glyph.tga: rows of 16 x 16 px, the 14 px glyph with its shadow: the gear (settings), expand and contract (full screen), the cross (close); each normal, then hover.
origin: Drawn by the design's TabbedWindow (its `cs-plates` group in the row's place, `.ctlbox.pl-row`, `CTRLS`): wow-dev-tools `design/scripts/corner-plates.mjs` writes a page from the component's own styles and glyphs, each state forced by a class; the page shot at 2x on black and on white with `design/scripts/shot.mjs --width 400 --height 600 --scale 2` (`?atlas=plates&place=row&bg=black`, `bg=white`, then `atlas=glyphs`), then matted.
